transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because I just don't have the push I used to. For things like choir, or... quilting. Visiting folks. 

Most days I just sit at home now with the TV on low. I know people are expecting me, but... I just don't go.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
No... I don't think so. I'm not crying or... sad, really. Just... I don't know. Just quiet, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot?
No... not really. I don't fret over things much. Just... mostly quiet in my head, I suppose.
Has your appetite changed?
I don't think so. I still eat... regular, I suppose. About the same as always.
Did this start after something stressful or a major change in your life?
No... I don't recall anything like that. Just... everything's been about the same. Nothing really changed.
Have you had any new medical illnesses or health problems around the time this loss of motivation began?
No... I don't think so. My health has been alright. No new sickness or anything like that.
Before this started, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt this same kind of loss of interest or motivation?
No... I don't think I have. Not that I remember, anyway. I've just... never really felt quite like this before.
Have you been having trouble with your memory?
No... not really. I remember things okay, I suppose. I haven't noticed any trouble with it.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest and motivation?
I suppose... a little over two years ago. It's just been building up since I retired from the school office.
Have you been feeling low on energy?
Not really... I mean, I don't do much these days anyway, so... I haven't really noticed feeling tired. It's just... about the same, I suppose.
Did your loss of motivation begin after you retired?
I suppose so... just around that time, yes.
Even if you wouldn't call it depression, do you feel emotionally flat most days?

I suppose... maybe flat is the word. I just don't have the push I used to. I used to do choir, quilting... visit folks. Now I just sit at home mostly. The TV is usually on low. I know people expect me to come around, but I just... don't.
Most days, do you feel down or hopeless?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't sit around crying or feeling sad, if that's what you mean. I'm not hopeless, I just... don't feel much about things either way anymore.
Have you been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease?
No... I haven't. No one has ever told me I have that.
Have people told you that your face seems less expressive than it used to?

I don't know... I don't really ask them. Maybe. Like I said before, I just don't have the push to go visit folks or do choir anymore... so I'm mostly just sitting at home with the TV on. I guess... I just don't have much reason to make expressions now.
Have you noticed any tremor in your hands?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. They don't shake.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than you used to?
No... I don't think so. I'm not in any hurry these days... so I just move how I move. I haven't noticed it being slower.
Have you noticed any stiffness in your arms or legs?
No... I haven't noticed that. They just feel like they always do, I guess. Not stiff.
Have you been having spells where you suddenly cry or laugh without meaning to?
No... I haven't had anything like that happen. I don't really... do that. Just normal, I guess.
Have you had any trouble swallowing?
No... eating is fine. It just goes down like normal, I guess. I haven't had any trouble with it.
